facts.fact: NIMC's director general says NINAuth processes over 1.3 million identity verifications daily for commercial banks, fintechs and government agencies onboarding citizens.
NIMC says banks, fintechs and government agencies use NINAuth to verify citizens at onboarding.
NIMC reports over 1.3 million identity verifications a day through NINAuth.

note: Published date used as as_of; the story gives none.
